diagnosis.summary: Payment-service is returning 5xx errors on 100% of requests with p95 latency at 4245.6 ms, up from a 4.5 ms baseline. Order-service is simultaneously returning 5xx errors on 50.4% of requests and shows 120 dependency errors per minute against payment-service, with p95 latency at 4257.5 ms. Both services are degraded in the current one-minute window.
diagnosis.root_cause: A complete failure in payment-service and a concurrent elevated failure rate in order-service, active at the same time, are the most likely root cause.
evidence: Payment-service 5xx error rate is 1.0 (100%) against a 0 baseline, and p95 latency rose from 4.5 ms to 4245.6 ms, approximately a 942x increase.
Order-service 5xx error rate is 0.5042 (50.4%) against a 0 baseline, and p95 latency rose from 25.1 ms to 4257.5 ms, approximately a 170x increase.

Order-service dependency error count is 120 per minute against a 0 baseline, and dependency p95 latency rose from 22.1 ms to 4715.4 ms, approximately a 213x increase; mean dependency latency rose from 16.2 ms to 4276.3 ms, approximately a 263x increase.
Payment-service lambda_duration_ms_mean rose from 0.59 ms to 2.59 ms, approximately a 4.4x increase.
Order-service db_latency_ms_p95 rose from 5.3 ms to 17.7 ms, approximately a 3.4x increase.
recommended_actions: Inspect payment-service Lambda logs and invocation errors immediately to identify what is producing its 100% 5xx error rate and near-4.25 s p95 latency.
Check payment-service Lambda concurrency and throttle counts at the account level, as lambda_duration_ms_mean has risen and every request is currently failing.
After stabilizing payment-service, recheck order-service error rate and dependency error count to determine whether its 50.4% 5xx rate and 120 dependency errors per minute persist independently.
Investigate order-service DynamoDB latency, which rose from 5.3 ms to 17.7 ms, as a potentially independent fault that may remain after payment-service is restored.
Consider applying rate and burst limits on the API Gateway stage while both faults are being worked to protect the rest of the stack.
